##### Project general facts

Oceanscape is a waterfront mixed-use development made up of residential towers, sea-facing townhouses set above the podium and boutique retail space. The retail component occupies the ground, first and second floors and spans the entire development, offering space for restaurants, cafés and speciality shops within the building.

The retail space benefits from a built-in audience of residents living in the towers and townhouses above, along with visitors from the surrounding neighbourhood. Shoppers and tenants are served by multi-level covered parking under camera supervision, while landscaped surroundings and a grand double-height reception area give the development a polished presence.

The building features reinforced concrete construction with aluminium-framed glazing and interior-designed common hallways. Residents enjoy an infinity pool overlooking the mangroves and the sea, a health club, steam and sauna rooms and a concierge service, creating a lively and affluent community around the shops.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Reem Island is a waterfront district just off the centre of Abu Dhabi, set against a backdrop of spectacular sea views. Its Al Shams area is a self-contained community bordered by mangroves on one side and an extensive waterfront on the other, with a network of canals.

The island offers business and residential towers, shopping centres, restaurants and cafés, along with open parkland, playgrounds and cycle paths. Residents and visitors have easy access to theatres, cinemas, outdoor dining, water taxis and dining boats, while Abu Dhabi International Airport and Dubai are within easy reach.

Master planned by international architects, town planners and designers, Al Reem Island combines business, residential and leisure uses in a balanced and harmonious community. Its prime seafront location and mix of homes, offices and attractions make the district an attractive choice for residents, retail tenants and investors.
